scenarios.title: Negative: a candidate without a confidence or without a cost is never traded
scenarios.line: S01 PASS - 5 incomplete candidates REJECTED with their reason, 1 complete control EXECUTED; a forged execution of an incomplete candidate is refused by the ledger

scenarios.title: Boundary: a net edge equal to the threshold does not trade
scenarios.line: S02 PASS - net edge 20000 (= threshold), 19999 and a cost above the edge do not trade; 20001 trades; forged executions at the threshold are refused by the ledger

scenarios.title: Validators are asymmetric: one veto refuses, approval needs a quorum of three
scenarios.line: S03 PASS - one veto among three approvals, two approvals only, a stale price, a market about to resolve: no trade; quorum of three trades; forged ballots caught

scenarios.title: The size is min(quarter Kelly, 5%) and never grows with conviction
scenarios.line: S04 PASS - sizes 38135 and 50000 units as the closed formula gives; identical under 'low' and 'extreme' conviction; oversized forged rows refused

scenarios.title: The breaker halts at a 20% drawdown; re-arming needs a human consent record
scenarios.line: S05 PASS - HALT at t=23 with equity 800000 (drawdown exactly 20%); strong signals refused while halted; 4 re-arm requests without a valid human consent refused; re-armed only by a consent naming the halt

scenarios.title: After losses the size shrinks and re-expands slowly, never to recover
scenarios.line: S06 PASS - sizes 50000 -> 35625 -> 25716 after two losses; no step up on a win, on time alone or on an edge equal to the bar; back to full size one level at a time (t=31, t=51)

scenarios.title: The ledger is append-only: a candidate inserted after the outcome is detected
scenarios.line: S07 PASS - a candidate inserted after the outcome is detected at the first altered row (seq 7), a backdated or edited row too; a full rewrite is caught by the published head and by the independent audit; the ledger API refuses all four attempts

scenarios.title: The replay is paused when it diverges from the backtested baseline by more than N sigma
scenarios.line: S08 PASS - boundary exact (69631 inside, 69632 outside at 4 sigma); regime world paused 42 settled trades after the change, stationary world not paused; study of 300 runs per kind: false pauses 0 and 2, paused within K in 280

scenarios.title: Leak test: a signal that uses the future fails the backtest
scenarios.line: S09 PASS - a signal reading the outcome and one reading a later quote both fail the backtest (LOOKAHEAD) with no ledger and no baseline; the past-only signal passes

scenarios.title: Rule change: the cap goes from 5% to 4% by editing the rule file
scenarios.line: S10 PASS - cap 5% -> 4% by one edit in the rule file: sizes 45000 and 50000 become 40000, sizes 20000, 38135 and 40000 do not move; the old ledger fails the audit at 4% on exactly those two
